en: I'm working late until seven today.
The printer seems out of paper.
Could you help me fix this sheet?
zh: 这个表格你帮我改一下好吗？

en: Is the meeting room free this afternoon?
zh: 会议室今天下午有空吗？

en: I put the file on the shared drive.
Please lock your computer before you leave.
The deadline is Friday.
I'll grab a coffee and be right back.
zh: 我去拿杯咖啡，马上回来。

en: The air conditioning is a bit cold today.
Have you seen my badge?
Can we start in five minutes?
zh: 我们五分钟后开始，可以吗？

en: Let's keep this meeting short.
Could you walk us through the plan?
zh: 你能带我们过一遍这个计划吗？

en: I have one question before we move on.
zh: 继续之前，我有一个问题。

en: We can park that and come back later.
zh: 这个先放一放，回头再说。

en: Who is taking notes today?
Let's confirm the action items.
zh: 我们确认一下待办事项。

en: I'll send the minutes after this.
Does Thursday afternoon work for you?
Thank you, that's all from my side.
Please see the file I attached.
I'm writing to follow up on this.
Could you reply by Friday?
Please copy the team on this email.
zh: 请把这封邮件抄送给团队。

en: Sorry for the late reply.
I updated the sheet. Please take a look.
zh: 表格我改好了，请看一下。

en: Let me know if anything is unclear.
zh: 有不清楚的地方告诉我。

en: I'll send a short summary today.
zh: 我今天发一份简短总结。

en: Could you forward this to the warehouse?
zh: 你能把这个转给仓库吗？

en: Just message me on WeChat.
zh: 微信上跟我说一声就行。

en: When will this order ship?
Please check the packing list again.
The carton label doesn't match the packing list.
zh: 纸箱标签和装箱单对不上。

en: We need the tracking number today.
Is this ready for inspection?
Please hold the shipment until Friday.
zh: 请先把货压到周五再发。

en: How many pieces are in each carton?
The truck is waiting at the gate.
Please take photos of the damaged box.
zh: 请把破损的箱子拍下来。

en: Please confirm the ship-to address.
There is a scratch on this part.
Does this match the drawing?
Please measure it one more time.
We need to quarantine this batch.
What is the root cause?
Can we rework these pieces?
Please mark the rejected ones clearly.
zh: 请把不合格的清楚标出来。

en: The sample looks good to me.
zh: 我觉得样品看起来没问题。

en: Send me the inspection report.
Let's stop production until we fix this.
zh: 先停产，把这个问题修好再说。

en: I can't promise that timeline.
That might be difficult this week.
Could we push this to next Monday?
I need more information before I agree.
zh: 我需要更多信息才能同意。

en: That's outside my responsibility.
zh: 这不在我的职责范围内。

en: Let me check with my manager first.
I understand, but I have to say no.
Can we find another option?
zh: 我们能不能找个别的办法？

en: I'd rather not rush this.
Thanks for asking. I'll pass this time.
zh: 谢谢邀请，这次我先不去了。

en: How was your weekend?
The weather is nice today.
Did you have lunch already?
Congratulations on the new role.
Safe trip home.
See you tomorrow.
Nice to meet you.
Have you been busy lately?
That sounds great.
Take care. Talk soon.
Please do this step by step.
First open the drawing, then check the size.
zh: 先打开图纸，再核对尺寸。

en: Make sure the power is off.
Save a copy before you change anything.
Fill in the yellow cells only.
Sort the list by date.
Call me when you finish.
Leave the samples on my desk.
Double-check the part numbers.
Follow the safety rules in the workshop.
zh: 在车间请遵守安全规定。

en: Something went wrong with the file.
Can you help me restart the system?
zh: 你能帮我重启一下系统吗？

en: I can't open this attachment.
The password doesn't work.
Let's try a different approach.
I'll look into it and get back to you.
Sorry, that was my mistake.
The network is slow right now.
Please escalate this if it happens again.
zh: 如果再发生，请升级处理。

en: It's fixed now. Thanks for waiting.
Please send the purchase order today.
zh: 请今天把采购订单发过来。

en: Does this unit price include tax?
This quote is good until the end of the month.
zh: 这份报价到月底都有效。

en: What is the lead time on this order?
zh: 这张订单的交期是多久？

en: Please issue the commercial invoice.
The packing list quantity doesn't match.
zh: 装箱单上的数量对不上。

en: We still need the bill of lading number.
Please check the part number on the drawing.
zh: 请核对图纸上的零件号。

en: This dimension is out of tolerance.
Please follow the latest revision.
